title: [REQUEST] My own custom progress bar module and more!
body:
**How would you improve Rich?**

A few months ago, I made my own custom progress bars that can be customised to look like emojis or text, I also made a function to make printing bars like --------- or ********** easier, and a function to surround a string with a character/emoji on either side. I know these features might have been already implemented but please check my repo.

**What problem does it solve for you?**

My progress bars are more customizable but may need some changes. Please check my repo for more info
Click here to go to [my repo](https://github.com/Mathdallas-code/Emoji-bars)
